gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: The official coloring page is available at the museum (10am - 2pm Wednesday and Saturday) or downloaded here or Facebook page. This is the only drawing that will be accepted for the contest - size 8.5x11. There are three age categories: #1-Under age 6 years, #2-Between 6 and 8 years and #3- 8 to 12 years. The child’s age shall be calculated as of 10/1/2026. An award will be given for each above age category.
